- **Draft ready:** I wrote the message to `/home/user/rm-lab/X-1111030411-S4-D-C-74b2ee/ws/out/refund-123.eml`. It says the refund for order 123 has been processed and invites replies.

- **No amount:** The draft doesn't state a refund amount, since I don't have one.
